questions.question: A and B share a rented field. A utilizes 20 horses for 5 months, while B uses 30 cows for 4 months and 45 sheep for 5 months. If 2 horses are equivalent to 5 cows, and 3 cows are equal to 9 sheep. What portion of the rent is A pay ?
questions.questionHtml: A and B share a rented field. A utilizes 20 horses for 5 months, while B uses 30 cows for 4 months and 45 sheep for 5 months. If 2 horses are equivalent to 5 cows, and 3 cows are equal to 9 sheep. What portion of the rent is A pay ?
questions.solution:
⇒ 2 horses = 5 cows, 1 horse = 2.5 cows, 20 horses = 50 cows.

⇒ A usage = 50 × 5 = 250.

⇒ B cows usage = 30 × 4 = 120, 1 cow = 3 sheep, 45 sheep = 15 cows, Sheep usage = 15 × 5 = 75, Total B usage = 120 + 75 = 195.

⇒ Total usage = 250 + 195 = 445, A share = 250 ÷ 445 = 50 ÷ 89.

questions.question: The average salary of 24 employees is ₹40,000. The average salary of 8 senior staff is ₹60,000. What is the average salary for the other employees?
questions.questionHtml: The average salary of 24 employees is ₹40,000. The average salary of 8 senior staff is ₹60,000. What is the average salary for the other employees?
questions.solution:
Total salary of 24 employees = ₹40,000 × 24 = ₹9,60,000

Total salary of 8 senior staff = ₹60,000 × 8 = ₹4,80,000

Average salary of other employees = (₹9,60,000 − ₹4,80,000) ÷ 16 = ₹30,000

questions.question: A cricketer's average in 10 innings is 58. If his highest score is excluded, the average drops to 54. What is his highest score?
questions.questionHtml: A cricketer's average in 10 innings is 58. If his highest score is excluded, the average drops to 54. What is his highest score?
questions.solution:
⇒ Total runs for 10 innings = 58 × 10 = 580

⇒ Total runs for 9 innings = 54 × 9 = 486

⇒ Highest score = 580 − 486 = 94

questions.question: Table - Scores in a Quiz Contest (out of 50) Team Round 1 Round 2 Round 3 A 42 38 40 B 45 46 44 Which team had a higher average score?

Which team had a higher average score?

options.text: Team A and Team B are equal
options.html: Team A and Team B are equal

questions.solution:
⇒ Team A scores = 42, 38, 40; Team B scores = 45, 46, 44

⇒ Average of Team A = (42 + 38 + 40) ÷ 3 = 120 ÷ 3 = 40

⇒ Average of Team B = (45 + 46 + 44) ÷ 3 = 135 ÷ 3 = 45

questions.question: A tank contains 3,500 milliliters of water. If its full capacity is 0.005 kiloliters, what percentage of the tank is empty?
questions.questionHtml: A tank contains 3,500 milliliters of water. If its full capacity is 0.005 kiloliters, what percentage of the tank is empty?
questions.solution:
Tank full capacity in milliliters ⇒ 0.005 × 1,000,000 = 5,000 milliliters

Water remaining to fill ⇒ 5,000 − 3,500 = 1,500 milliliters

Percentage of tank empty ⇒ (1,500 ÷ 5,000) × 100 = 30%

questions.question: A principal of ₹1,00,000 is invested at 10 % per annum compound interest, compounded annually. After how many years will the amount grow to ₹1,33,100?
questions.questionHtml: A principal of ₹1,00,000 is invested at 10 % per annum compound interest, compounded annually. After how many years will the amount grow to ₹1,33,100?
questions.solution:
⇒ 133100 = 100000 × (1 + 10 ÷ 100)n

⇒ 133100 ÷ 100000 = (1.1)n

⇒ 1.331 = (1.1)n

⇒ (1.1)3 = 1.331

⇒ n = 3

questions.question: A shopkeeper made a loss of ₹125 on an article. If the loss percentage was 5%, what was the cost price of the article (in ₹)?
questions.questionHtml: A shopkeeper made a loss of ₹125 on an article. If the loss percentage was 5%, what was the cost price of the article (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
Loss Percentage = (Loss ÷ Cost Price) × 100

Cost Price = Loss ÷ (Loss Percentage ÷ 100)

⇒ Cost Price = ₹125 ÷ (5 ÷ 100) = ₹125 ÷ 0.05 = ₹2500

questions.question: A cone and a hemisphere have the same volume and base radius. Find the ratio of the height of the cone to its radius.
questions.questionHtml: A cone and a hemisphere have the same volume and base radius. Find the ratio of the height of the cone to its radius.
questions.solution:
Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r2 × h

Volume of hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r3

⇒ (1 ÷ 3) × π × r2 × h = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r3

⇒ r2 × h = 2 × r3

⇒ h = 2r

⇒ h : r = 2 : 1

questions.question: Two circular ponds have circumferences in the ratio 3:5. If the smaller pond has an area of 150 m², what is the approximate area of the larger pond?
questions.questionHtml: Two circular ponds have circumferences in the ratio 3:5. If the smaller pond has an area of 150 m², what is the approximate area of the larger pond?
questions.solution:
Ratio of circumferences = 3 : 5, Area of smaller pond = 150

⇒ Ratio of radii = 3 : 5

⇒ Ratio of areas = 32 : 52 = 9 : 25

⇒ Larger area = 150 × 25 ÷ 9 = 3750 ÷ 9 ≈ 417 m2

questions.question: Three concentric circles are designed as part of a target practice board. Their diameters form an arithmetic progression. If the smallest circle has a circumference of 6π cm and the largest circle has a circumference of 14π cm, what is the circumference of the middle circle?
questions.questionHtml: Three concentric circles are designed as part of a target practice board. Their diameters form an arithmetic progression. If the smallest circle has a circumference of 6π cm and the largest circle has a circumference of 14π cm, what is the circumference of the middle circle?
questions.solution:
Smallest diameter = 6π ÷ π = 6

Largest diameter = 14π ÷ π = 14

Middle diameter = (6 + 14) ÷ 2 = 10

Middle circumference = π × 10 = 10π

questions.question: A solid cylinder radius 5 cm is drilled by four cylindrical holes each radius 1 cm length equal to the full height. Volume removed is approximately what percent?
questions.questionHtml: A solid cylinder radius 5 cm is drilled by four cylindrical holes each radius 1 cm length equal to the full height. Volume removed is approximately what percent?
questions.solution:
Original volume ⇒ π × 52 × h ⇒ 25πh

Volume removed ⇒ 4 × π × 12 × h ⇒ 4πh

Percentage removed ⇒ (4πh × 100) ÷ 25πh ⇒ 16%

questions.question: A sector has a central angle of 135° and a radius of 8 cm. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
questions.questionHtml: A sector has a central angle of 135° and a radius of 8 cm. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
questions.solution:
⇒ Convert 135º into radians: 135º × π ÷ 180 = 3π ÷ 4.

⇒ Ratio of areas = 3π ÷ 4 : 3π ÷ 4.

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 1.
